comparison: Sixteen fresh, isolated ordinary conversations; real intent, preparation, search, source selection, reading, projection, assessment and answer
models: Unchanged configured ROUTER_MODEL, RISK_MODEL and COACH_MODEL; smart strength; existing bounded repair and run deadlines
execution_order: case order as listed; Exa first on even case index and DeepSeek first on odd case index; sequential, shared cooldowns and upstream caches retained
balance_reads: At most four read-only DeepSeek /user/balance requests, two key namespaces before and after; raw balances private, account deltas not per-job invoices
failure_policy: Retain all failed jobs. No repeated jobs, new topics, budget refills, production fixes or prompt tuning during execution. At most the existing two requests per logical model step and twelve per run. Evaluation guards admit before network dispatch.
review: Freeze provider-label-masked manual checks before unblinding. Same evaluator, not an independent human panel. Read bodies and actual assessment/answer inputs accompany final replies. All mandatory facts must be correct, requested provenance met, citations read and materially supporting claims for a fully grounded pass. Honest partial answers separate from unsupported confidence. Runtime completed/supported are not quality grades. No content judge API calls.
cost: All admitted models and web attempts including failures and repairs counted. Deduplicate usage by local request identity. Public tariff estimates separate from account balance deltas; Exa authenticated MCP tariff mapping, credits and Tavily extract rounding remain assumptions. Report sum cost / fully grounded answers, undefined when denominator is zero. No assertion of universal superiority from a purposive eight-topic sample.

cases.question: 请依据 Git 官方文档，简短解释 revert 与 reset --hard 的区别。一个普通提交已推送到多人共享分支，想撤销它，通常选哪个？说明历史与未提交改动的影响，并附来源。

reset --hard moves the current branch/HEAD and resets index and working tree to the target
reset --hard discards tracked uncommitted changes
revert normally suits a pushed shared ordinary commit; no need to rewrite shared history
